label: Count distinct posits along an acyclic regress against a finite alternative (inference)
rule: Compose injectivity of a descending acyclic chain with separate charges, then compare extended natural and exact cardinalities
meaning: This is a conditional application of cardinal parsimony. The headcount theorem fixes the charged carrier; charging beings as tokens and charging independent explanatory assumptions can produce different verdicts. With a common countably infinite inventory, the exact cardinalities of all objects agree in the displayed example. The finite-fiber companion counts only visited charges: finitely many positions per charge force infinitely many charges on an infinite sequence, even without a common bound on group sizes. Pairwise billing is an existing example; mixed even/odd billing shows that an infinite group can coexist with infinitely many charges. Empirical adequacy and philosophical preference require separate assessment.
